source: SAP Discovery Center Business AI catalogue
note: English, text-only snapshot of the Embedded AI Features listed in the Discovery Center Business AI catalogue on the capture date. Embedded AI features shipped inside SAP products (type ai_feature). Detail page: https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-feature/{uuid}. domain/processes/productCategories codes decode via ai-dictionary.json. Catalogue presence is availability-to-validate with the customer, not an entitlement and not proof of GA. Omission does not establish retirement. Internal ranking/routing fields are not retained. Maintainers replace this copy deliberately; no runtime refresh or API connection.
